family_reports.body: It has torn my family apart. It has given my kids nightmares about being ripped away from me. Emotional and Mental abuse caused by the case workers and state workers. Constitutional Rights were violated. Etc.
I’ve missed time with my daughter. Holidays and what not. She’s been severely struggling without her mom present. No concern from the courts and no interest in reunification.
They literally destroyed and tore apart my family piece by piece until I literally had NOTHING left!!!

DHS refused to encourage reunification. Put my daughter in teachers home instead of family. My daughter has been manipulated against me. I can’t concentrate at work, depression, PTSD, anxiety. This has destroyed our family!!

Our family has been destroyed by DHS, Foster Care, Judicial system, Familes First, 4 Oaks, it has caused so much pain & heartache. Now I have custody of my oldest granddaughter, but the youngest is still with the Bio father of my oldest granddaughter.
